mentions.name: Bowerjack
mentions.description: This invite-only web app makes themed playing cards with AI: users create a deck on any theme, supply their own art or have an AI agent research and find Creative Commons/public-domain art that's licensed for printing, then download print sheets to cut locally on a Cricut or order from online playing card vendors. Planned expansion covers other paper goods built from many individual elements, such as 12-month and 365-day calendars, field guides, affirmation cards, and tarot cards. The author also published a whitepaper on the token, time, and cost efficiency of different implementation approaches.
mentions.source_excerpt: https://bowerjack.com - make subject playing cards with AI (eventually: multiple types of paper goods where we have a lot of individual elements, like 12-month and 365-day calendars, field guides, affirmation cards, tarot cards, etc) Create a deck of cards on any theme, drop art yourself or have your AI agent research and find creative commons/public domain art that's allowed to be printed, and download sheets to print locally and cut on your Cricut, or order from one of a few online playing card vendors. Currently invite-only. I have been spending a lot of effort making this token-efficient, and wrote a whitepaper about token, time, and cost efficiency of different approaches here: https://bowerjack.com/whitepaper
